title: ranunculus obovatus
intro: Ranunculus obovatus, commonly known as the Small-flowered Buttercup, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to improve digestive health and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus obovatus include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
